resources.string:
1. Personal Information

FitTrack stores your fitness and activity details to help you track your progress.

2. Data Storage

Your information is stored locally in the app database.

3. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal information.

4. Notifications and Reminders

Notifications and reminders work only when you enable them.

5. Data Export and Backup

You can export or back up your activity data from Settings.

6. Notification Controls

You can disable notifications and reminders anytime.

7. Data Protection

We respect your privacy and aim to keep your information safe.

Thank you for using FitTrack!
